Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about me, Prospergenics and working together.

Who is Lessy?

I’m Lessy, a software developer and WordPress specialist. I’m a co-founder and trainer at Prospergenics, where I build websites, web apps, automations and AI agents.

Is Lessy the same person as Finehas Mpoe?

Yes. My full name is Finehas Lesiamon Mpoe. Most people call me Lessy, so that is the name I use.

What is Prospergenics?

Prospergenics is a software and AI development team across the Netherlands and Kenya. I’m one of its co-founders, alongside Martien de Jong. I build software there and teach other developers. You can meet the team at prospergenics.com.

What can I hire Lessy for?

WordPress websites and custom themes, web apps, AI agents and agent skills, workflow automations, and training for developers. The services page has the details.

Do you build WordPress sites with Elementor?

Yes. WordPress is my strongest skill: custom themes, Elementor builds and complete business websites.

What are AI agents and automations?

AI agents are programs that take on tasks for you, such as answering customer questions, sorting email or preparing content. I build them, along with reusable skills for those agents and workflows that connect your tools, for example with n8n.

Can I see examples of your work?

Yes. The projects page lists everything, from farm and gallery websites to AI assistants. Each project has its own page with the technology used.

Which technologies do you use?

WordPress, Elementor, PHP, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, .NET and n8n, depending on what the project needs.

Do you work with clients outside Kenya?

Yes. My projects include clients in Kenya and in Europe, including Dutch businesses.

Do you also teach?

Yes. Training and mentoring developers is part of my work at Prospergenics.

How do I contact you?

Email lessy@prospergenics.com or mpoelessy839@gmail.com, or message me on WhatsApp. The contact page has all the ways to reach me.

Does this website track visitors?

No. It sets no cookies and runs no analytics. Read the privacy policy for the details.
